description: Search the server's message history through Discord's native search index. Covers every channel the bot can read, or one channel if you name it, and looks inside embeds and polls, not just plain text. Matching is whole-word full text, not substring, so search for words rather than fragments. Filter by author, by what a message carries (image, link, file, and so on), or by pinned state, and order by newest first or by relevance.

author.description: Only messages from this member (name or ID).

channel.description: Limit to one channel by name or ID. Default: the whole server.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

has.description: Only messages that carry this kind of content.

limit.description: Max results to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging. Default 0.

pinned.description: Only pinned (true) or only unpinned (false) messages.

query.description: Words to look for. Whole-word full text match, not substring. Optional if you filter by author, has, or pinned instead.

sort.description: Order by newest first (recent, the default) or best match (relevant).

name: search_messages
title: Search messages
